title: 第320章 山主预言第319章 老道说
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 门外安静了好一会儿，王易抬起眼皮，问：“你知道的只有这么多？”
老道士摇摇头，露出了神秘的笑容：“还有别的，怕你不敢听。”
有什么不敢的，还能遭天谴不成？
王易让老道士放心大大说：“出了事儿我兜着。”
老道士闻言笑了一声：“你兜不住怎么办？”
那能怎么办？
大不了就一死呗。
王易又不怕死，死着死着就习惯了。
“哦，对了。”
老道士想起了一个关于山主的故事。
“传说中，山主遇到过一个问题，祂亲自下了山，想寻找一个神秘的不死者。”
“不死者？”
“就是死不掉的人。”
死不掉的人是什么人？
所谓仙人不死，是因为祂们死了还能活，并非死不掉。
这个所谓的不死者又是什么东西？
王易思索许久，也没什么头绪。
老道士说：“应该是一个活着的人。”
王易又问：“是仙人吗？”
走入轮回的仙人，在某种意义上来说也算是不死者了。
老道士摇了摇头，说自己也不确定。
事实上，不死者只存在于山主留下的预言中。
老道士顿了顿，说：“我有两种推测，其一，这个人是真的杀不死，打造了一个独一无二的轮回道基，藏在一个神秘的地方。”
不死者每次出现都会有不同的身份，戴上一张截然不同的人皮面具。
就算你杀了他，不用多久，这个家伙还会像海边的潮水一样卷土重来，周而复始，没完没了。
即便是山主，也很难在一片大海中找到一粒毫无动静的沙子。
“另一种推测的？”
老道士说：“这个人从来都没有出现过，只是山主的幻想。”
“幻想？”
“或者说，是预言。”
预言里的人只会出现在一个地方，未来。
山主预见到未来会出现一个不死者，极有可能推翻仙路，开启另一个宏大的时代。
content_en:
There was silence outside the door for a while. Wang Yi raised his eyelids and asked, "Is this all you know?"
The old Taoist priest shook his head and showed a mysterious smile: "There are other things, I'm afraid you won't dare to listen."
If you dare not do anything, will you still be punished by God?
Wang Yi reassured the old Taoist priest and said, "I will take care of you if anything happens."
The old Taoist priest laughed when he heard this: "What should you do if you can't hold it back?"
What can be done?
The worst case scenario is death.
Wang Yi is not afraid of death, he is used to it.
"Oh, right."
The old Taoist priest remembered a story about the mountain owner.
"Legend has it that the mountain owner encountered a problem. He personally went down the mountain to find a mysterious undead."
"Immortal?"
"He's the one who can't die."
Who are the people who cannot die?
The so-called immortals are immortal because they can still live after death, not because they are immortal.
What is this so-called undead thing?
Wang Yi thought for a long time and had no idea.
The old Taoist priest said: "It should be a living person."
Wang Yi asked again: "Is he an immortal?"
Immortals who have entered reincarnation are considered immortals in a sense.
The old Taoist priest shook his head and said that he was not sure either.
In fact, the undead only exist in the prophecies left by the mountain master.
The old Taoist paused and said, "I have two speculations. One is that this person is really unkillable and has created a unique Taoist foundation of reincarnation and hidden it in a mysterious place."
The undead will have a different identity every time they appear, wearing a completely different human skin mask.
Even if you kill him, it won't take long for this guy to come back like the tide on the seashore, over and over again, endlessly.
Even if you are a mountain owner, it is difficult to find a motionless grain of sand in a sea.
"Another speculation?"
The old Taoist priest said: "This person has never appeared. It is just the fantasy of the mountain owner."
"Fantasy?"
"In other words, it's a prophecy."
The people in the prophecy will only appear in one place, the future.
The mountain owner foresaw that an undead would appear in the future, which would most likely overturn the Immortal Road and usher in another grand era.
